title: Signature Global acquires 10-acre land parcels in Gurugram to build realty projects - The Economic Times
text:
Signature Global has successfully acquired two land parcels in Sohna, Gurugram, covering around 10 acres as part of its initiative to bolster its project portfolio. This strategic move complements the company’s focus on expanding its footprint in lucrative regions. Recently, Signature Global also secured a substantial land bid in Raigad, Maharashtra, signaling its ambitions beyond the Delhi-NCR area.
